page.layout: One printed page, single column of text; running head at top centre with page number at top left; faint show-through from the facing page on the right and in the margins (not transcribed).

main_text.head: NOMINVM COLORVM explicatio.
main_text.p: Albus charopus, pilis subalbidis cameli similis vel ungui lapillo. Charopus tamen apud Galenum oculis leonis similis dicitur.
Subspiceus fit, si parum spicei humoris succo claro, ut aqua est, mieceris.
Subaureus, qui non puro auro similis.

page.notes: The page-number and running head are printed at top; the last line "Subcroceus" is set right-aligned and is treated as a paragraph, not a catchword in the strict sense. Lines of the list are set as printed with long s rendered as plain s.
